gates.name: Inspect tarball
gates.command: tar -tzf <tarball>; assert no src/, no tsconfig*.json, no .test.* artifacts, package/dist/ present

gates.name: Consumer smoke
gates.command: clear consumer-smoke/{node_modules,package-lock.json,dist}; npm run install:engine && npm run build && npm run smoke

gates.name: Validate Markdown links, terminology, and generated files
Build and verify landing page
gates.command: npm --prefix src/engine run build; npm --prefix site run check

gates.name: Merge landing page into documentation build
Positive route and probe smoke
gates.command: build/run host image; curl /, /roadmap/, /docs/, /health/live, /health/ready -> 200; unknown route -> 404

gates.name: Negative fixture -- corrupted artifact must fail to start
gates.command: docker build -f tools/host-smoke/Dockerfile.negative-fixture ...; run must exit non-zero
